title: RAW UNREVIEWED: repeated chol updates one retained source and creates separately recoverable extracts
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Nominate the complete existing f29v.1–4 paragraph, including both written chol-chol pairs, for a small iteration hypothesis. Cennini LXII supplies an owned craft mechanism: fresh lye repeatedly extracts blue from the same retained pastello; the outputs stay separately addressable until individual assessment, and only then may selected outputs be pooled. Explore chol as one repeatable extraction operation, without importing the old dry/degree dictionary or filling the remaining paragraph with new nouns.

design.mechanism: An operation updates a continuing residue while appending a new extract to an ordered collection. Its output state remains a valid input to the same operation; the extracted portion and the remaining source have different later duties.
design.unit: The entire40-group ZL f29v.1–4 paragraph printed as JP04 in GDT809, retaining the reported alternate readings. The two chol-chol occurrences are not treated as detached two-word texts. No new image or manuscript unit is requested.
design.contrast: Non-idempotent iteration producing distinct extracts versus a repeated material-quality statement/intensifier, or a transformation that replaces the entire source with one finished product.
design.prediction: If the selected chol is the proposed repeatable operation, two applications before exhaustion require two separately recoverable extracts and a source still available for the second application. Immediate pooling before individual assessment loses an obligatory later action. Replacing the first residue with its extracted output changes the source of the second operation. Global renaming of the substances does not remove these differences.
actual_positive_referents: GDT809 retains two adjacent chol-chol pairs in the complete f29v paragraph; .3 has three-reader support and .2 only two-reader support. Its whole-paragraph comparison explicitly leaves the repeats unexplained rather than silently intensifying or deleting them.
The live GDT608/318 baseline supports directed composition and contextual rendering without identifying an operator. Repetition of a whole form is real input; it does not itself prove iteration.

The complete Cennini LXII text is already owned in CENNINI_FINE_DRY_FRACTIONS_SOURCE_OFFER_20260922.json, with subsequent native print review of all five pages in CENNINI_LXII_NATIVE_SEPARATE_FRACTIONS_REVIEW_20260922.md. New lye is placed on the explicitly retained pastello; the first, second and later extracts are separately stirred and assessed before permitted grouping.
additional_assumptions: One whole, chol, tentatively contributes EXTRACT_STEP. This is one new working value, not a new value for ch, ol or any related form.
A written or explicitly hypothesized local state frame carries one residue plus an ordered output collection. The second chol receives the first operation's residue, not the first extracted liquid.
Each application obtains a fresh extracting portion and a distinct output address. This allocation is an explicit construction cost; the repetition alone does not establish either fact.
The source's exhaustion condition must be represented if the whole reading invokes the stopping/discard branch. It may not be silently inferred from the paragraph ending.

finite_core.single_step: If source_can_still_yield, EXTRACT_STEP(S, fresh_extracting_portion, fresh_receiver) yields S' with an updated retained_source and one additional independently owned output.
finite_core.repetition: EXTRACT_STEP composed with EXTRACT_STEP is defined on the same state type. Under the explicit non-exhaustion guard, its two outputs remain distinct even if their names or measured amounts are equal.
finite_core.later_obligation: ASSESS_EACH must precede any chosen POOL operation; DISCARD_SOURCE follows the exhausted-source condition, not the first extraction.
finite_core.lexical_budget: One proposed content operation. Source, solvent, receiver, comparison and stop roles are currently variables and unfilled obligations, not additional assigned target words.
finite_core.unknowns: No group has a confirmed meaning. Apart from the four conditional chol positions in the ZL draft, all36 positions remain unassigned under this hypothesis. The reported RF difference at the first pair is retained; a universal two-step reading cannot be claimed there without its literal realization.

design.strongest_known_countercase: GDT685 has343 chol occurrences on125 pages and extensive value-field contacts; its old dry/quality rendering is a genuine competing working account, although unconfirmed. GDT809's chor-chol-daiin contexts on complete f21r/f32v paragraphs also remain obligations for any later portable chol operator. The local f29v paragraph currently has no written source/output identity construction, and its first doublet is not exact in all readers. The source alone cannot supply those missing target participants.
design.smallest_next_step: Write one fixed EXTRACT_STEP state-carry construction for the complete existing f29v paragraph, with the same signature at every local chol and no additional lexical values. Identify exactly which written context would introduce the retained source and distinguish each output; leave every other group visible. Check the second application and the source/output swap rival before any dictionary extension. If the frame cannot be written, retain a raw unbound candidate. A later transfer decision must confront the already owned chor-chol-daiin clauses rather than declaring this a universal operator from one paragraph.
design.predecessor_distinction: The Cennini source offers already contain the residue/separate-assessment insight; it is not newly discovered here. This card adds a concrete whole-paragraph nomination and a one-operation compositional candidate. GDT944's formation/separation sentence at f80v remains unresolved and is not continued or repaired. GDT1005's240-record FULL/DELTA mold-account writers remain contradicted; this different LXII mechanism does not relax their source or packing contract. IDEA515's nested sieve-cut model and the old f21r/f32v powder lexicon are not imported.
design.source_layer: Cennini's medieval craft work is owned here through Tambroni1821 and earlier native print collation, not a newly inspected medieval manuscript. The problematic printed non in the18/3/6 grouping example remains unresolved; no exact grouping arithmetic or universal mixing prohibition is used.
design.claim_ceiling: Unreviewed exploratory candidate. No whole translation, source identity, independent meaning evidence or decoded operation. No experiment or new target admission.
